record.title: Falsify the complete SPU prediction in stock Sparrow
record.intent: Validate software-selected SPU initialization and identify the next unsatisfied boundary.
requirements: Run one fresh disposable guest using the privately tested executable and pinned inputs against unchanged stock artifacts.
Validate452 ADC writes then all eight SPU writes with live selection evidence; stop on first mismatch or next access without adaptation.
Independently verify raw software inputs, exact accesses, register preservation, terminal shadows, thread coverage and cleanup.
Distinguish static predictions, runtime software state, synthetic write acceptance and uncompleted accesses; make no FPGA acceptance or useful UI claim without evidence.
acceptance: A reproducible positive or negative conclusion is committed and pushed before successor execution.
